notes.title: Opening Salvo: Early Access
notes.content:
After a slight hiccup, we're ecstatic to announce the early access release of Radio Violence on Steam. In its current incarnation, Radio Violence is local multiplayer only and requires controllers to play. That said, a few of the things that are coming down the line as features going forward include:
[list]
[*] Online Multiplayer
[*] Single player / vs. AI play
[*] Mouse and Keyboard support
[/list]

With all that said, we'd love to hear your feedback on the game, so feel free to drop us a line on any of the various social media platforms at @nosleepsoftware, or drop by our twice-weekly [url=www.twitch.tv/nosleepsoftware]No Sleep Twitch stream[/url] on Monday and Friday at 8PM EST.

Break the silence with Radio Violence!
